info.name: Starfish Space Website Content API (WordPress REST v2) Pattern Directory API

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: category
params.description: Limit results to those matching a category ID.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Limit results to those matching a keyword ID.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to those matching a pattern (slug).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of pattern directory from the Starfish Space WordPress REST API.
